record.paper_title: Open Problems in Affine Algebraic Geometry: Problems for Problem Session
record.context_brief: Generation of volume-preserving polynomial automorphism groups
record.original_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let Aut*_k k[n] be the group of polynomial k-automorphisms of k[x1, ..., xn] with Jacobian determinant 1. For a subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n], say that G is generated by locally nilpotent derivation exponentials if some set of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] generates G through elements exp D. Say that G is finitely generated in the stronger source sense if a finite set of locally nilpotent derivations D generates G through all elements exp(fD) with f in Ker D. Is Aut*_k k[n] generated by locally nilpotent derivation exponentials, and if so, is it finitely generated in this stronger sense?

evidence.quote: A subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n] is called ∂-generated if there exists a set G of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] such that G is generated by the elements exp D, where D in G.

A subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n] is called finitely ∂-generated if there exists a finite set G of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] such that G is generated by the elements exp fD where D in G and f in Ker D.
Problem 2.1. Is the group Aut*_k k[n] ∂-generated? If yes, is it finitely ∂-generated?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, let $n>1$ be an integer, and let $k^{[n]}=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the polynomial ring in $n$ variables. Denote by $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$ the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms of $k^{[n]}$ whose Jacobian determinant equals $1$ (the volume-preserving polynomial automorphisms).

A $k$-derivation $D$ of $k^{[n]}$ is called locally nilpotent if for every $f\in k^{[n]}$ there exists an integer $m\ge 1$ with $D^m(f)=0$; for such $D$ the formal exponential $\exp D=\sum_{m\ge 0} D^m/m!$ is a well-defined element of $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$, and for every $f\in\ker D$ the product $fD$ is again locally nilpotent, so $\exp(fD)\in\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$.

Call a subgroup $G\le\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$ $\partial$-generated if there exists a (possibly infinite) set $\mathcal G$ of locally nilpotent $k$-derivations of $k^{[n]}$ such that $G$ is generated by $\{\exp D : D\in\mathcal G\}$. Call $G$ finitely $\partial$-generated if there exists a finite set $\mathcal G$ of locally nilpotent $k$-derivations such that $G$ is generated by $\{\exp(fD) : D\in\mathcal G,\ f\in\ker D\}$.

Question: Is $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$ $\partial$-generated? If yes, is it finitely $\partial$-generated?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the affine algebraic geometry problem-session literature on generation of the Jacobian-determinant-1 polynomial automorphism group by exponentials of locally nilpotent derivations. A web search returned only general references on locally nilpotent derivations and polynomial automorphism groups (Freudenburg's monograph, related papers), with no announcement of a solution for general $n>1$. Hence the status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Reference monograph on locally nilpotent derivations and exponential automorphisms; no resolution of the ∂-generation question for Aut* k^[n].
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference does not record a resolution of the ∂-generation problem.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism groups of affine varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on automorphism groups of affine varieties discussing exponentials of locally nilpotent derivations.
status_evidence.claim: No proof that Aut*_k k^[n] is (finitely) ∂-generated is reported.
